answer: Stop sybils with an event-attendance passport. First, each agent attends a registered event and the venue signs a credential stamped with time and place, like a pearl sealed at a wharf. Second, earning rights need three credentials from three venues in 90 days, so one fake visit buys nothing. Third, venues are spot-audited; one caught selling fake stamps loses its license and all its credentials burn, plus a 300 POA bond. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 attendances at $40 each, $1,200,000, plus 10,000 travelers. Like a kernel inside every pearl, one real presence anchors one identity.
